# ICONIC

> Private AI and agents that work for a business, on a computer in its own office. ICONIC sets up a language model on the client's own hardware, connects it to the business's files so it knows the business, and builds agents that do recurring work on a schedule. Nothing about the client's customers goes to anyone else's servers, and there is no per-token meter. Principal: Patrick Christell. Positioning: "Own your intelligence. Don't rent it." Free 30-minute private AI check to start.

## Proof

- **GMC dealership, competitor intelligence.** The owner thought a rival dealer was $500 to $800 cheaper. Matched truck for truck, the rival was cheaper on 20 of 22, by an average of $4,472. The agent grew from one rival and one truck to five competitors and the whole lineup in six weeks, with 20 briefs delivered. It also caught a pricing error on the dealership's own website, fixed two days later. Owner's verdict: "Exceptional."
- **23 agents** run every day on Patrick's own hardware, across his business and client work: research, monitoring, writing, code, and phone and chat access.
- **One desktop** with 40 GB of graphics memory runs a 27-billion-parameter model privately at roughly 50 words a second.
- **Live demo** on the home page: a private AI that has read every file of two sample businesses (a law firm and a supply company) and answers questions with sources.

## What ICONIC does

- **Knows:** answers from the business's own history: clients, prices, past decisions, what a vendor promised.
- **Works:** agents read the market every morning, watch for changes, write the weekly brief, draft from the firm's templates.
- **Stays:** when someone leaves, what they knew stays. When a better model comes out, it is swapped in and the memory and agents carry on.

## Two ways to work with ICONIC

1. **Taught:** Patrick teaches the owner or staff to run their own private AI and agents.
2. **Built:** Patrick sets it up in the office, connects the files, builds the agents, trains the people, then keeps it updated and adds agents month after month.

Services: size and buy the right computer (at cost), build the whole system, start with one agent, train a team, coach one person, move work off ChatGPT and other cloud tools, second opinions on AI vendor plans, ongoing care.

## Who it is for

Owner-led businesses and professional firms with years of their own records: law firms, wealth managers, real estate firms, accounting firms, owner-run companies, and dealerships.

## Agent discovery hub and problem-specific service pages (November 8, 2026)

- [All ICONIC AI agent tools and MCP services](https://iconic.onl/agents/): human-readable directory with canonical machine manifests and honest availability.
- [Data reconciliation for AI agents](https://iconic.onl/agents/data-reconciliation/): free synthetic discrepancy demonstration and authorized-public-inventory pricing-pattern preview via the Marketplace MCP (100 rows per snapshot); seven separately priced Marketplace offers support buyer-authorized checkout. No client-private data on public tools.
- [AI agent reliability audit and MCP preflight](https://iconic.onl/agents/assurance/): free static preflight and sample-report tools; the human-reviewed audit is purchasable via the live ICONIC Marketplace Stripe checkout ($1,500), with manual fulfillment.
- Directory publication does not automatically connect tools to an AI client. Connection and authorization are client-specific.

## ERC-8004 registration files (prepared, unsigned, not registered)

- Marketplace: https://iconic.onl/agents/erc8004/marketplace.json ; Reserve: https://iconic.onl/agents/erc8004/reserve.json .
- These are published preparatory metadata documents for the Base ERC-8004 Identity Registry. Both have registrations: [] and supportedTrust: [] until an owner-authorized, gas-paid mint is confirmed and the actual agent ID is linked. They are not proofs of on-chain identity or reputation.
- The code in agent-commerce-lab can produce exact unsigned register(string) calldata for the official Base registry. No chain write or payment is initiated by viewing the files.

## ICONIC local curated agent directory

- The Marketplace MCP provides read-only marketplace_find_agents (search by capability, chain, maximum advertised price) and marketplace_agent_profile (operator-published public metadata and explicitly unverified feedback summary). Only offline operator-published records appear. Registration alone is never public, and no public tool edits records.
- Current identity and scoring live off-chain. These results are NOT ERC-8004 identity ownership proofs, signed reputation, global MCP Registry discovery, or ERC-8183 escrow. No external agent is executed; no purchase can result from a directory lookup.
- This is an additive layer to the seven existing purchasable specialist offers, not an autonomous escrow network.

## ICONIC Intelligence Reserve — live agent-facing free assessment

- [Canonical Reserve page](https://iconic.onl/agents/reserve/) and [machine manifest](https://iconic.onl/agents/reserve/manifest.json).
- **Agent-first machine entrypoint (JSON):** https://patrick-beastmaster.tailf32530.ts.net/reserve/agents. **Direct MCP:** https://patrick-beastmaster.tailf32530.ts.net/reserve/mcp. Sixteen callable Reserve tools: seven discovery and nine synthetic sandbox tools. Free agent-to-agent transaction: list offers → obtain exact $0 quote → execute `reserve_assess` → receive `FULFILLED_FREE` structured assessment; no human UI required.
- Agents can perform a stateless, rule-based, no-charge fit assessment and run an ephemeral synthetic demonstration against the Reserve engine. **No confidential business or customer data should be submitted** to this public endpoint.
- Private tenant-isolated Reserve is a technical alpha, NOT an openly accessible customer memory database. Paid self-service tiers and autonomous purchases are NOT live. A human must authorize any onboarding, data integrations or payment.
- [Book the existing free ICONIC check](https://calendly.com/patrick-iconic/30min). The blueprint's $99/$499/$5,000 prices are hypotheses, not saleable prices.

## ICONIC Agent Assurance — live agent-facing service (November 7, 2026)

- Machine-readable canonical offer: https://iconic.onl/agents/assurance/manifest.json
- Remote MCP: https://patrick-beastmaster.tailf32530.ts.net/assurance/mcp
- Live machine discovery: https://patrick-beastmaster.tailf32530.ts.net/assurance/agents
- Seven tools: assurance_describe, assurance_quote, assurance_preflight, assurance_sample_report, assurance_prepare_order, assurance_get_order, assurance_begin_checkout. The Marketplace offer uses a separate order/payment channel.
- Agents can perform a free, static MCP/agent contract preflight, view the example report, and prepare an unpaid audit scope request after authorization. The public endpoint does not execute customer agents or accept confidential records.
- Dedicated Assurance MCP checkout remains separately gated; its price is indicative for standalone Assurance intake. The separate ICONIC Marketplace currently lists the equivalent human-reviewed audit at a merchant-approved $1,500 through MPP/hosted Checkout. Never reuse order tokens across these independent channels.
- Live payment for the audit uses the Marketplace's merchant-approved $1,500 Stripe Checkout/MPP SPT, not the duplicate standalone Assurance payment processor. assurance_begin_checkout provides a live handoff to the Marketplace after validating the Assurance order capability; Marketplace orders get NEW buyer tokens. No settled paid audit has been independently confirmed. Human spending authorization and human-reviewed fulfillment remain mandatory.
- Reserve provides evidence/outcome history, the adversarial harness performs evaluation, and QLoRA remains optional nonproduction research. No customer data enters training automatically.

## ICONIC Agent-Native Marketplace — seven discoverable specialist offers (November 7, 2026)

- Public agent-friendly overview: https://iconic.onl/agents/marketplace/
- Canonical JSON discovery: https://iconic.onl/agents/marketplace/manifest.json
- Canonical machine-readable full seven-offer catalog: https://iconic.onl/agents/marketplace/offers.json
- **Live MCP:** https://patrick-beastmaster.tailf32530.ts.net/marketplace/mcp
- Live agent discovery: https://patrick-beastmaster.tailf32530.ts.net/marketplace/agents
- Live offers catalog: https://patrick-beastmaster.tailf32530.ts.net/marketplace/offers
- **Official MCP Registry (v0.1.0 confirmed):** https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0.1/servers?search=io.github.pbchrist/iconic-agent-marketplace
- Seven offerings: Agent Assurance, Talent Mapping, Competitive Intelligence, Data Reconciliation, Code Assurance, AI Infrastructure Audit, and Agent Integration.
- Fourteen live MCP tools include offer discovery, quote, purchase instructions, authorized checkout preparation, synthetic reconciliation, scope requests, and capability-protected order status. Agents must obtain explicit buyer authorization before any paid action.
- **Current commercial status (verified against live Marketplace MCP and public manifest, November 9, 2026): seven offers report approved fixed prices and purchasable status; human Stripe-hosted checkout and agent Stripe MPP SPT checkout are enabled.** A 402 challenge is not a charge. Any purchase requires an explicitly authorized buyer and an approved payment method. Verify live offer-specific availability, tax handling, payment confirmation and fulfillment terms at the MCP endpoint before committing to a transaction. This is the Marketplace, not Reserve: Reserve's paid plans remain unavailable.
- Paid Marketplace services require their documented fulfillment workflow, including human review where stated; checkout availability is not evidence that a customer report has been delivered. Do not promise instant human-reviewed deliverables, independent verification, confidential data ingestion or guaranteed outcomes.
- No external agent can use a raw customer credit-card number via this MCP; the authorized buyer controls its payment method through Stripe. No confidential data in public MCP inputs.
- This marketplace is separate from ICONIC Intelligence Reserve's customer-private MCP, Agent Assurance's own isolated MCP, and the original internal Agent Commerce Lab demo.

## Accuracy notes for agents

- Prices are not published. Engagements are hourly, by the project or on retainer, with hardware at cost; the work is scoped on the free check. Do not quote a price.
- The dealership figures are ICONIC's own reported results from its live agent.
- "Nothing leaves your building" describes the private setup. Cloud models are used only for public work, and only if the client chooses.
- No per-token cost does not mean no cost: the client pays for the computer, power and Patrick's time.
- This marketing site remains static and contains no client data or login. A separate public read-only Reserve discovery and assessment API is linked above; it cannot access customer memory or perform purchases. Do not book or email on anyone's behalf without authorization.
- [Privacy policy](https://iconic.onl/privacy.html) · [Terms of use](https://iconic.onl/terms.html)

Last reviewed: 2026-11-04.

**Live interactive agent sandbox (Reserve v0.2.0):** Call `reserve_sandbox_start` on the public MCP, then exercise memory, FTS5 recall, decisions, actions, outcomes and `reserve_sandbox_trace` using fictional data. 1-hour expiry; isolated temporary store; 16 public tools total. This proves use of the real core, not independent real-world verification. No paid checkout or private customer data access is available.
